subject: Human Body
title: The Hand and Wrist
description: Learn The Hand and Wrist in one minute.

hook.text: Your hand has 27 bones: more than your entire leg. That density gives you incredible fine control.

buildup.text: Eight carpal bones form the wrist. Five metacarpals make the palm. Fourteen phalanges form the fingers.

discovery.text: The thumb's saddle joint lets it oppose other fingers. No other primate has this range of opposition.

twist.text: Your fingers have no muscles. Tendons from forearm muscles pull them like puppet strings.

climax.text: The hand's design lets you thread a needle and grip a hammer. Precision and power in the same tool.

punchline.text: 27 bones, zero finger muscles. All controlled from afar.

quiz.question: Where are the muscles that move your fingers?
options: In the palm of the hand
